findings.claim: Endpoint-coordinate contrasts over the observed window are dominated by shape (second-moment) descriptors rather than centroid translation: shape_yy shows the strongest integrated high-low contrast (z=-0.513, q=1.5e-5, 0/14 batches positive), with shape_xx (z=-0.495, q=8.1e-4) and shape_zz (z=-0.183, q=0.067) aligned in sign. Centroid components are weak or null (global_centroid_x z=-0.111, q=0.257; global_centroid_z z=-0.061, q=0.481), with only global_centroid_y reaching significance (z=-0.243, q=0.014). This is a signed favorable-versus-comparison contrast at the observed selection nodes, not an absolute geometric target.

The continuous contrast functions are non-monotone across the full observed support: landmark_00_local_dy has 6 sign changes with first_rate_z=-72.4 and last_rate_z=+5.5; landmark_00_local_dx has 6 sign changes (first_rate_z=-17.5, last_rate_z=+8.1); landmark_00_soft_mass has 4 sign changes (first_rate_z=+9.3, last_rate_z=-10.0). No polynomial was accepted and extrapolation is disallowed, so a constant rule is not supported and only observed-node interpolation is admissible.

Endpoint contrasts and within-window temporal deltas disagree in magnitude and sign for several features: shape_yy has a large integrated contrast (z=-0.513) but a positive last-minus-first delta (z=+0.148), and shape_xx has a large integrated contrast (z=-0.495) with a near-zero delta (z=+0.002). This indicates the integrated high-low separation is not simply a monotone within-window drift, so endpoint-integrated credit and temporal-derivative credit must be treated as distinct quantities.

hypotheses.falsifier: If a constant rule matches the observed-node contrast values within the reported relative_node_RMSE across the window, the time-conditioned hypothesis is rejected.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dx / landmark_00_local_dy / landmark_00_soft_mass observed-node contrast values
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast rule (using validated observed-node interpolation of the landmark local-contrast curves) will express the endpoint shape separation better than a constant rule, because the supplied contrast functions change sign within the observed window.

hypotheses.falsifier: If centroid components show equal or larger multiplicity-adjusted integrated contrasts than the shape components, the shape-priority hypothesis is rejected.
hypotheses.observable: shape_xx / shape_yy / shape_zz integrated high-low contrast z
hypotheses.scope: observed selection nodes, complete observed window
hypotheses.statement: The dominant endpoint shape (second-moment) contrast, not centroid translation, is the coordinate pattern most consistent with favorable-versus-comparison separation at the observed selection nodes.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or final affinity outcomes are supplied; endpoint-integrated contrasts are coordinate contrasts, not evidence of final affinity benefit.
Continuous-trend rows are diagnostic coordinate contrasts; they are not absolute reward targets and no extrapolation beyond the observed window is permitted.
Joint/coupling, survival, increment and turnover tables were not read in this budget; coupling and survivor-bias questions remain unaddressed.
No temperature or reward-parameter edit is proposed; temperatures are immutable task parameters.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto

task.objective: Final predicted target affinity primary; validity and strain secondary; coordinate control only
task.task_wording: Interpret the supplied evidence and answer the coordinate-design task.
